usedFor: Shopify holds carts and orders and Espo CRM holds leads, so “Abandoned Checkout” can run “Create Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create Lead” in Espo CRM
bestTemplate.why: A shopper who left with an email or phone becomes a lead your team can follow up.

watchOut: “Create Lead” takes contact details, so a checkout without an email or phone gives your CRM little to chase.
